In the 1990s demand for them surged with the rise of electronic music and electronic dance music. In the 21st century, as digital audio workstations spread, every kind of controller appeared, such as DJ controllers and production controllers. A MIDI controller is an input device and electronic instrument that turns physical actions such as pressing keys, touching, striking or blowing into Musical Instrument Digital Interface (MIDI) data; for the most part it does not sound on its own and has to be connected to a sound module, synthesizer, sampler or digital audio workstation to play. Common forms include keyboards, drum controllers, wind controllers and string controllers, with buttons, knobs, faders, pedals and sensors that send parameters such as pitch, duration, velocity and pitch bend. It belongs to the controllers of digital music technology and is used mainly in the modern recording studio, in electronic music production, on stage and for synchronised theatre control. Its sounding class is electrophonic, Hornbostel–Sachs 542.
MIDI控制器本身不產生聲音，而是通過電子信號控制音樂軟件或合成器發聲。其音色完: A MIDI controller makes no sound itself; it controls music software or a synthesizer by electronic signals. Its timbre depends entirely on the sound source or software library it is connected to. It can produce anything from a bright, clear electronic synthesizer sound to the warm, thick tone of an emulated instrument. Its range is in theory unlimited and can cover every instrument's frequency range. Its strength is flexibility: it can switch instantly among thousands of tones, imitate a piano, strings or winds, or create wholly virtual soundscapes. Unlike traditional instruments, whose resonance depends on physical vibration, MIDI timbre is decided by digital algorithms, which can reproduce a real instrument's character precisely or create surreal effects; it is a core tool of modern music production.
MIDI控制器起源於1980年代的美國和日本。隨著MIDI（樂器數位介面）標準於: The MIDI controller originated in the United States and Japan in the 1980s. With the MIDI (Musical Instrument Digital Interface) standard established in 1983, music production entered the digital age. Early MIDI controllers were developed mainly by keyboard makers such as Yamaha and Roland, to connect synthesizers with computers.
